titulo_fr: Une lettre de réclamation : Observer les formes
titulo_es: A formal claim: Vocabulary and forms
intro: It recognizes the problem, the evidence cited and the solution requested in a claim. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: It recognizes the problem, the evidence cited and the solution requested in a claim. It separates the fact of its context: the verbal times, connectors and powers indicate when and who provides each data.
Attention: Courtesy formulas keep the formal record; « en effet » introduces a test and « par conséquent » a request. In this fragment, «reçu» means «receipt».

frases.fr: J'ai joint une photographie ainsi qu'une copie du reçu à ce message.
frases.es: He adjuntado una fotografía y una copia del recibo a este mensaje.
frases.en: I have attached a photograph and a copy of the receipt to this message.

frases.fr: Le produit fonctionne, mais son écran est rayé; je souhaiterais donc un remplacement.
frases.es: El producto funciona, pero su pantalla está rayada; por eso desearía un reemplazo.
frases.en: The product works, but your screen is scratched; therefore I would like a replacement.
